turns.content: Before treatment, E. coli inhibition zones were 25 mm for ampicillin, 23 mm for azithromycin, and 5 mm for meropenem; the respective susceptibility cutoffs were 17, 15, and 10 mm. Using greater than cutoff as susceptible, classify all three results.
After acridine orange was added, neither a bacterial lawn nor inhibition zones were present. Why can antibiotic susceptibility no longer be read from that plate?
The culture contained 0.1 mg/mL acridine orange and was incubated at 200 C. Which condition most plausibly explains the absence of growth?
Explain why that no-growth plate cannot demonstrate successful plasmid curing, using both the pretreatment results and the incubation condition.
Recalculate the pretreatment meropenem category directly from its zone and cutoff.
Use the pretreatment ampicillin category in the comparison.
Does the sequence 'acridine-orange exposure, then no growth' by itself establish that the dye caused the outcome when 200 C incubation occurred simultaneously?
Explain how the timing of acridine-orange exposure and simultaneous incubation at 200 C affects causal attribution.
Report the pretreatment antibiotic categories and explain what can and cannot be concluded about acridine orange and the absence of growth.
Give the best explanation for the absence of growth based on the susceptibility results and incubation conditions.
